svg.title: The system map, by the five verbs Train, Check, Verify, Record and Act
svg.desc: A volunteer takes the photo test on /t and the Worker keeps the per-feature score in D1. Vision models take the same test, and the pass table says which features each may flag. On /check the Worker hands the answers, the dry days and the person's score to the follow-up selector, which returns at most two questions. The finished visit becomes a record of human answers only, then a FHIR Bundle stored in D1, checked by the HL7 validator in CI and mirrored to their sandbox. From the stored visits, core/act.py works out what the creek needs and which pipes are worth testing, a pipe becomes a ServiceRequest, and the read only MCP server hands any agent the same records with their ids.
